AMF Client 2.0.1 — FFmpeg/x264 corresponding source and build record

Corresponding-source artifact to distribute with the Windows x64 portable:
AMF-Client-2.0.1-FFmpeg-x264-Corresponding-Source.zip

IDENTIFIED BINARIES

The five DLLs in the portable are byte-identical to the files in
ddnet-libs commit d5f0cd9194936d1ab5bd19952645b8dffe9ae06c and report FFmpeg
7.0.1. Their SHA-256 values are:

avcodec-61.dll    58C71BAA592DA746C9C5E30FDD41814A2736454B2B7168DA4AB88585758D4786
avformat-61.dll   B72292ED8140957752E45880B597B6E1A673FB66E740379D29614DEE1454D3A2
avutil-59.dll     CD256113D455D362D769A859D2214B9F672BE8D2692EEBD7539675D31620CA6B
swresample-5.dll  011C439C98BE2FB44D0364D872BDA437E2A618E89594E60CA3E63A6FF5FB8FD2
swscale-8.dll     6473E9D9D5A595A09205251D7B2FEA1C4111D8DCE98C55BC99A6EF4B88FE0BE8

The avutil_configuration string embedded in the DLLs includes --enable-gpl,
--enable-libx264, --enable-encoder='libx264,aac', and the Windows x64
MinGW target. FFmpeg reports the libraries as GPL version 2 or later.

SOURCE IDENTIFICATION

FFmpeg source: official release ffmpeg-7.0.1.tar.gz, tag n7.0.1, peeled
upstream commit af25a4bfd2503caf3ee485b27b99b620302f5718.
SHA-256: E273EAE00B4F833595654C1EE2B2349240E0332F9DBF3C4CADD39DF9819FF052
The upstream detached signature was verified with the FFmpeg release key
fingerprint FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8.

x264 source: VideoLAN x264 commit
4613ac3c15fd75cebc4b9f65b7fb95e70a3acce1.
Source archive SHA-256:
7C0E4A312075BBF0AC8AC1F23E8CC7F4A41B0EA5F934C9CF2D01A15FC4886ED0

The x264 commit is not encoded in the DLL. Its identity was reconstructed
from the binary's PE link timestamp (2024-07-16 17:44:53 UTC), the embedded
x264-master build path, and the upstream DDNet dependency script at commit
0f98f238f78bd106b40c9711e6d3e30a25e4ac66, which downloads the x264 master
archive and FFmpeg 7.0.1 source. At the build-time cutoff, upstream x264
master resolved to 4613ac3c15fd75cebc4b9f65b7fb95e70a3acce1; the next master
commit is dated 2024-09-17 and has 4613ac3 as its parent. The subsequent
DDNet script revision f2ac502f55ed652902aafc32dc7fa7aeff7a21cb corrected
the FFmpeg 7.0.1 DLL output names to the 61/59/5/8 ABI names. The DLL
configuration string matches the Windows x64 FFmpeg configure command in
that script history. No FFmpeg or x264 source patches are recorded by that
build script.

This is a provenance reconstruction from the upstream source-acquisition
procedure, PE timestamp, embedded configuration, and public upstream history;
the x264 revision is not a value directly embedded in the binary.

BUILD CONFIGURATION

The historical dependency script describes a Debian 10 chroot with MinGW-w64
cross-compilers. It does not record exact GCC, binutils, NASM, or MinGW package
versions. Therefore the source inputs and configuration are identified, but
bit-for-bit reproducibility of the existing DLLs is not claimed.

x264 configure options used for Windows x64:
  --enable-static --disable-cli --disable-gpl --disable-avs --disable-swscale
  --disable-lavf --disable-ffms --disable-gpac --disable-lsmash
  --disable-interlaced --host=x86_64-mingw32
  --prefix=/usr/x86_64-w64-mingw32
  --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32-

FFmpeg configure options recovered from the embedded configuration and the
matching historical build recipe (paths below are the recorded builder paths):
  --disable-all --disable-alsa --disable-iconv --disable-libxcb
  --disable-libxcb-shape --disable-libxcb-xfixes --disable-sdl2 --disable-xlib
  --disable-zlib --enable-avcodec --enable-avformat
  --enable-encoder='libx264,aac' --enable-muxer='mp4,mov'
  --enable-protocol=file --enable-libx264 --enable-swresample --enable-swscale
  --enable-gpl
  --extra-cflags='-I/home/deen/isos/ddnet/debian10/root/win64/x264-master'
  --extra-cxxflags='-I/home/deen/isos/ddnet/debian10/root/win64/x264-master'
  --extra-ldflags='-L/home/deen/isos/ddnet/debian10/root/win64/x264-master'
  --arch=x86_64 --target_os=mingw32
  --cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32- --disable-static --enable-shared
  --extra-libs='-lpthread -lm' --pkg-config-flags='--static'

The source artifact also contains the safe, focused rebuild script at
licenses/third_party/FFmpeg-x264-build-win64.sh. It is provided as build
guidance, not as evidence that the existing binaries can be reproduced
byte-for-byte with an unpinned toolchain. SHA-256 values for the downloaded
source archives, signature, and verification key are listed in
licenses/third_party/FFmpeg-x264-SHA256SUMS.txt.

LICENSES

The FFmpeg source archive contains its upstream COPYING.LGPLv2.1,
COPYING.GPLv2, and other license files. x264 source contains its upstream
COPYING file. The corresponding-source artifact includes the relevant full
GPLv2 and x264 license texts separately for convenient inspection. Preserve
all upstream copyright and license notices in redistributed source and
binaries. This record is technical provenance, not legal advice.
